other_conditions: The student must have secured minimum 75% marks in class 10th.
The girl student should be studying regularly in class 11 or 12.
The girl child must have a bank account to receive the benefit.
Application must be made online through the school principal on the Shaladarpan portal.
benefits_summary: Rs. 3,000 per year paid to eligible 11th and 12th grade girl students on Basant Panchami.
